claim_boundary: Post-v2.4.1 training-view expansion evaluated on three newly declared seeds and a new held-out expression family. A pass would show access preservation under this denser training-view coverage; it would not by itself establish improved expression generalization or comparability with the harder v2.4.1 held-out family. Each seed independently executes one continuous shared-state L1-L5 protocol. The L4 component audits MOVE/RETURN response eligibility, absolute access, and relative access preservation; it does not replace the separate eight-endpoint, 28-relation geometric discrimination audit. This is not an untouched replication of the original method, cross-model confirmation, autonomous instruction execution, arbitrary program closure, gradient-free memory operation, capacity scaling, or global transport.
